name: Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon 2027
short_description: A sold-out full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) held 7 May 2026 in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon is scheduled for 7 May 2026 in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia, with the start and finish based around the Likas Stadium area. Runners can choose between a full marathon (42.195 km) and a half marathon (21.1 km), both organized by the Kinabalu Running Club. Registration for this edition is currently sold out, so those interested in participating will need to look ahead to future editions.

faqs.question: Where is the Borneo International Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in the Likas Stadium area of Kota Kinabalu, in the state of Sabah, Malaysia. This venue serves as the base for the event, which is organized by the Kinabalu Running Club and draws runners to this specific location on the island of Borneo.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The event offers two distance categories: a full marathon covering 42.195 km and a half marathon covering 21.1 km. This gives participants the choice to take on either the complete marathon distance or the shorter half marathon option, depending on their training and goals.

faqs.question: Can I still register for this race?
faqs.answer: No, registration for this edition of the Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon is currently listed as sold out. Prospective participants who missed signing up will need to wait for registration to potentially reopen for a future edition of the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Borneo International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The event is organized by the Kinabalu Running Club, a local organization based in Sabah, Malaysia. They oversee the planning and execution of both the full marathon and half marathon races held around the Likas Stadium area in Kota Kinabalu.
